method: CSCL pedestrian-eligible streets, bridges, tunnels, paths and steps; vehicle-only segments and alleys excluded. Bidirectional endpoint graph with elevation codes and 0.1m coordinate rounding. Entrances and destinations snapped to nearest eligible segment, connector distance included. 80m/min; no crossing waits, accessibility or schedules. Shaded street bands use 35m cartographic buffers, not parcel-level accessibility polygons.
